label: Matt 27:1
text: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

label: Matt 27:2
text: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

label: Matt 27:3
text: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

label: Matt 27:5
text: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

label: Matt 27:6
text: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

label: Matt 27:7
text: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them, to bury strangers in.

label: Matt 27:8
text: Therefore that field was called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

label: Matt 27:11
text:
Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
Jesus said to him,
“So you say.”

label: Matt 27:12
text: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

label: Matt 27:13
text: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

label: Matt 27:14
text: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

label: Matt 27:15
text: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.

label: Matt 27:16
text: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

label: Matt 27:17
text: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?”

label: Matt 27:19
text: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

label: Matt 27:21
text:
But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?”
They said, “Barabbas!”

label: Matt 27:22
text:
Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ?”
They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

label: Matt 27:24
text: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

label: Matt 27:25
text: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us, and on our children!”

label: Matt 27:26
text: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

label: Matt 27:27
text: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

label: Matt 27:28
text: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

label: Matt 27:29
text: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

label: Matt 27:30
text: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

label: Matt 27:31
text: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

label: Matt 27:32
text: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

label: Matt 27:33
text: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

label: Matt 27:34
text: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

label: Matt 27:35
text: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

label: Matt 27:37
text: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

label: Matt 27:45
text: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

label: Matt 27:48
text: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

label: Matt 27:49
text: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

label: Matt 27:51
text: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

label: Matt 27:52
text: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

label: Matt 27:53
text: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

label: Matt 27:55
text: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

label: Matt 27:56
text: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

label: Matt 27:57
text: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple came.

label: Matt 27:58
text: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

label: Matt 27:59
text: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

label: Matt 27:60
text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

label: Matt 27:61
text: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

label: Matt 27:62
text: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

label: Matt 27:63
text: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

label: Matt 27:64
text: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

label: Matt 27:65
text: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

label: Matt 27:66
text: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

text:

the price of him upon whom a price had been set,
whom some of the children of Israel priced,

statement: While Pilate sat on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying she had suffered much in a dream because of the righteous man.

label: Pilate washed his hands before the crowd and declared himself innocent of Jesus' blood
statement: Pilate took water and washed his hands before the multitude, declaring himself innocent of the blood of the righteous man; the people answered, 'His blood be on us and on our children.'

label: A condemned man was flogged (scourged) by Roman soldiers before being handed over for crucifixion
statement: Jesus was flogged (scourged) by the governor's soldiers before being handed over to be crucified - the Roman scourging custom of 27:26.

label: Jesus was crucified by order of Pontius Pilate
statement: Jesus was crucified at the order of Pontius Pilate (27:26-35), at Golgotha outside Jerusalem.

label: The governor had a headquarters (praetorium) in Jerusalem
statement: The governor had a headquarters (praetorium) in Jerusalem.

label: The soldiers stripped Jesus, dressed him in a scarlet robe with a reed, and mocked him as king
statement: The governor's soldiers stripped Jesus, put a scarlet robe on him, put a reed in his right hand, knelt, and mocked him, 'Hail, King of the Jews!', spat on him and struck his head.

label: A crown plaited from thorns was woven and put on his head
statement: The soldiers braided a crown out of thorns and put it on his head (27:29).

label: The soldiers compelled Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross
statement: Coming out, the soldiers found Simon of Cyrene and compelled him to carry the cross of Jesus (27:32).

label: The crucifixion took place at Golgotha, 'the place of a skull', outside the city
statement: They came to a place called Golgotha, 'the place of a skull', where he was crucified - outside the walls of Jerusalem of that time.

label: The condemned was offered sour wine mixed with gall before execution
statement: They gave Jesus sour wine mixed with gall to drink; he tasted it and would not drink (27:34).

label: The executioners divided the condemned man's clothing among themselves by casting lots
statement: When they had crucified him, the soldiers divided his clothing among them by casting lots (27:35).

label: A written placard stating the charge was set up over the crucified man's head
statement: They set up over his head the written accusation against him: 'THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS' (27:37).

label: Darkness covered the land from the sixth hour until the ninth hour
statement: From the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour (27:45).

label: A soldier gave the crucified man sour wine (vinegar) on a sponge raised on a reed
statement: One of the bystanders ran, filled a sponge with vinegar (sour wine), put it on a reed and gave him drink (27:48).

label: The veil of the Jerusalem temple was torn in two from top to bottom
statement: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom (27:51).

label: The earth quaked and the rocks were split at the time of the crucifixion
statement: The earth quaked and the rocks were split (27:51); the centurion and his men saw the earthquake (27:54).

label: Tombs were opened and many bodies of sleeping saints were raised and appeared to many
statement: The tombs were opened; many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised, came out of the tombs after his resurrection, entered the holy city and appeared to many (27:52-53).

label: Women who had followed Jesus from Galilee, among them Mary Magdalene, watched the crucifixion and sat opposite the tomb
statement: Many women who had followed Jesus from Galilee and served him watched from afar, among them Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James and Joses; Mary Magdalene and the other Mary sat opposite the tomb.

label: Joseph of Arimathea, a rich disciple, asked Pilate for the body of Jesus and received it
statement: Joseph of Arimathea, a rich man and disciple of Jesus, came in the evening, went to Pilate, asked for the body, and Pilate commanded it to be given up (27:57-58).

label: The body was wrapped in linen and laid in a new rock-cut tomb closed with a great rolled stone
statement: Joseph wrapped the body in clean linen and laid it in his own new tomb cut in the rock, and rolled a great stone against the door of the tomb (27:59-60).

label: The chief priests and Pharisees posted a guard and sealed the stone of the tomb
statement: On the day after the Preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees gathered to Pilate, asked for the tomb to be secured until the third day; Pilate gave them a guard, and they sealed the stone and set the guard (27:62-66).

label: Matt 27:4
text: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

label: Matt 27:10
text: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

label: Matt 27:18
text: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

label: Matt 27:20
text: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

label: Matt 27:23
text: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

label: Matt 27:36
text: and they sat and watched him there.

label: Matt 27:38
text: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

label: Matt 27:39
text: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

label: Matt 27:40
text: and saying, “You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

label: Matt 27:41
text: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

label: Matt 27:42
text: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

label: Matt 27:43
text: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

label: Matt 27:44
text: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

label: Matt 27:46
text: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

label: Matt 27:47
text: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

label: Matt 27:50
text: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

label: Matt 27:54
text: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God.”

label: The governor's soldiers took Jesus into the praetorium and gathered the cohort
statement: The governor's soldiers took Jesus into the praetorium and gathered the whole garrison (cohort) against him.
